tha-ap164:1.1: Kaṇaverapupphiya.] Siddhattho nāma bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / purakkhato sāvakehi nagaraṃ paṭipajjatha. // //
tha-ap164:2.1: Rañño antepure āsiṃ-gopako abhisammato / pāsāde upaviṭṭho 'haṃ addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap164:3.1: Kaṇaveraṃ gahetvāna bhikkhusaṅghe samokiriṃ / Buddhassa visuṃ katvāna tato bhiyyo samokiriṃ. // //
tha-ap164:4.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pupphapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap164:5.1: Sattāsītimhi 'to kappe caturo āsuṃ mahiddhikā / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā. // //
tha-ap164:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Kaṇaverapupphiyo thero i. g. ā-ti. Kaṇaverapupphiyattherassa
